# M0.1 Risk remediation — H-M0-006 v4

## Verdict

**IMPLEMENTED; AWAITING INDEPENDENT SKEPTIC REVIEW.** The bounded Risk controls are
implemented at `091f0af316682e141354c2ba014eab86ee46392b`. This is not project
approval, STOP clearance, paper/live permission, a capital unlock or proof of an
external trust channel. `STOP-M0-001` remains OPEN. Capital remains conceptual USD
50.00, deployable/reserved USD 0.00, live LOCKED, kill ENGAGED.

## Controls delivered

- Quant `SCIENTIFIC_INTEGRITY_CONSISTENT` evidence is consumed only after local
  binding checks, a verifier-supplied externally authenticated trust policy, exact
  authority generation and durable one-time replay consumption. Its explicit false
  operational/paper/live/Risk fields remain false.
- Authority policy resolves canonical actors, aliases, roles, scopes, conflicts,
  revocation and generations. Approvals bind exact subjects and policy generation.
  Self-review, alias ambiguity, duplicate approvers and stale/untrusted authority
  deny. Local code does not claim to authenticate real people or protect a hostile
  host.
- Lifecycle state is reduced from a sequenced digest chain. Skips, conflicts,
  future events, terminal resurrection, M0 live states and resume-by-edit deny.
  PAPER_ELIGIBLE and PAPER_TRADING require exact independent roles, scientific
  evidence and an ALLOW STOP decision; eligibility remains non-authorizing.
- STOP snapshots must be trusted, complete, fresh and match the verifier's exact
  inventory. OPEN scope propagates through typed dependencies with global
  precedence. Candidate clearance requires a separate typed event, remediation,
  revalidated descendants and current independent authorities including Risk when
  capital is implicated. The real STOP was not cleared.
- Integer-minor-unit paper/live ledgers are separate and event-derived. Conservation,
  nonnegative balances, reservations/liabilities, unique settlement, compensating
  correction and fresh exact reconciliation are enforced. There is no arbitrary
  credit event.
- Position, daily, strategy, source, event and shared-correlation exposure are
  calculated. Mandatory event/selection/strategy/source/market keys prevent
  duplicated opinions from appearing diversified. Unresolved live limits deny.
- The kill switch is latched and generation-based. Triggers invalidate pending
  authorization; reset requires non-M0 phase, trusted Risk attestation, remediation,
  healthy controls and STOP ALLOW. Exposure-neutral settlement/reconciliation can
  continue while engaged.
- The machine decision separates science, lifecycle, paper/live eligibility,
  capital, current controls and per-action authorization. Each missing layer denies.
  Live is independently denied in M0, while LOCKED status and zero deployable
  capital are separate denials.

## Positive and rejection evidence

The isolated synthetic positive path reaches PAPER_TRADING eligibility only after
all staged approvals and returns no execution authorization. A synthetic paper
decision authorizes only when every current control and an explicit current
per-action token are supplied. These fixtures do not alter project state.

Rejections cover untrusted/self-issued/stale authority, missing replay state,
commitment replay and ID collision, lifecycle skips/resurrection/conflicts,
self-review, applicable/missing/stale STOP state, incomplete clearance, money
creation/negative balance, duplicate settlement, stale reconciliation, mixed
paper/live ledgers, correlated concentration, unresolved live thresholds, M0 reset,
STOP-trigger races and eligibility without individual authorization. The exact map
is `reports/risk-remediation/findings-to-tests.v1.json`.

## External assumptions and remaining gates

No independently controlled production controller, authenticated human/cryptographic
identity channel, credential/key custody, hostile-host replay store, replicated
durability, live account, venue adapter or cross-system atomic transaction boundary
is provisioned. Collusion, controller compromise, false external observations and
undisclosed off-system activity remain outside local guarantees. Empirical live
limits and freshness/price tolerances remain unresolved; live therefore denies.

Independent Skeptic review must reproduce the frozen implementation and evaluate
these boundaries before Director disposition. Even a favorable review would not by
itself clear the STOP or unlock capital; the separate issuer/substitute, domain,
Risk, descendant-revalidation and audit process remains mandatory.
